WITH jan AS (
  SELECT SUM(eur_amount) AS vol,
         SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(has_fraudulent_dispute), COUNT(*)) AS fr_count,
         SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_fraudulent_dispute THEN eur_amount END), SUM(eur_amount)) AS fr_value
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND year = 2023 AND day_of_year BETWEEN 1 AND 31
),
bands AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN vol < 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN vol < 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vb,
    CASE WHEN fr_count < 0.072 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN fr_count < 0.077 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN fr_count < 0.083 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fb_count,
    CASE WHEN fr_value < 0.072 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN fr_value < 0.077 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN fr_value < 0.083 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fb_value,
    vol, fr_count, fr_value
  FROM jan
),
txns AS (
  SELECT card_scheme, is_credit, aci,
         CASE WHEN issuing_country = acquirer_country THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS intracountry
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND year = 2023 AND day_of_year = 12
),
fees AS (
  SELECT * FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`
),
matched AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.ID,
    (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = b.fb_count) AS fr_count_ok,
    (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = b.fb_value) AS fr_value_ok

FROM txn t

  AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(r.aci) = 0 OR t.aci IN UNNEST(r.aci))
  AND (r.intracountry IS NULL OR r.intracountry = CAST(t.is_intra AS INT64))

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT merchant, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS mo,
    SUM(eur_amount) AS mvol,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)), SUM(eur_amount)) * 100 AS fraud_pct
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND year = 2023
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
txn AS (
  SELECT p.*, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL p.day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS mo
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  WHERE p.merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND p.year = 2023 AND p.day_of_year = 12
),
m AS (SELECT * FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.merchant_data` WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso'),
t AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, t.card_scheme, t.is_credit, t.aci, t.issuing_country, t.acquirer_country, t.mo,
    mo.mvol, mo.fraud_pct,
    CASE WHEN mo.mvol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN mo.mvol <= 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN mo.mvol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_band,
    CASE WHEN mo.fraud_pct < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN mo.fraud_pct <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN mo.fraud_pct <= 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fraud_band,
    m.capture_delay AS m_cd, m.account_type AS m_at, m.merchant_category_code AS m_mcc
  FROM txn t
  JOIN monthly mo ON mo.mo = t.mo
  CROSS JOIN m
),
cd AS (SELECT t.*, CASE WHEN t.m_cd = '2' THEN '<3' ELSE t.m_cd END AS cap FROM t)
SELECT f.ID, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.psp_reference) AS matched_txns
FROM cd
JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
  ON (f.card_scheme IS NULL OR f.card_scheme = cd.card_scheme)
 AND (f.account_type IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type) = 0 OR cd.m_at IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
 AND (f.merchant_category_code IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code) = 0 OR cd.m_mcc IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
 AND (f.aci IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci) = 0 OR cd.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
 AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = cd.is_credit)
 AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = IF(cd.issuing_country = cd.acquirer_country, 1, 0))
 AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = cd.cap)
 AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = cd.vol_band)
 AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = cd.fraud_band)
GROUP BY f.ID
ORDER BY f.ID
